A [[Codru-Ji]] was the '''mate''' of a [[Unidentified Codru-Ji governor|governor]], and they had a son, [[Rikki]]. The [[Governor/Legends|governor]] invited [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] to dinner at their home and the mate and governor greeted him warmly when he arrived. However, Rikki, who was still in his [[wyrwulf]] stage, pounced on Hoole and knocked him to the ground. Hoole reacted instinctively and called Rikki a "mangy beast," causing Rikki to jump off and start whining. The governor told Hoole that his son was not a mangy beast and Hoole immediately apologized, using a customary Codru-Ji  gesture. The governor accepted Hoole's apology, advising Hoole to give Rikki a scratch behind the ears so that his son was forgive him as well. Hoole did as the governor advised, and Rikki licked Hoole's fingers in response. The two proceeded with their meeting, although the governor's mate was noticeably cooler towards Hoole after the incident.<ref name="EGTAS" />
